title: Implement real ICRC-1 SUZHI token minting and wire wallet balance/transfer to it

requirements.text: Implement a real ICRC-1-compatible SUZHI token ledger in the existing Motoko single-actor canister (backend/main.mo), replacing the current in-memory-only balance Map behavior so balances are minted, transferred, and queried via ICRC-1 semantics.
acceptanceCriteria: The canister exposes standard ICRC-1 query endpoints for token info and balances (e.g., name/symbol/decimals/fee/total_supply/balance_of) and a standard ICRC-1 transfer endpoint.
Token balances are tracked in persistent state (survive canister upgrades).
The existing dashboard can retrieve the authenticated user's balance without showing 0 due to missing minting.

requirements.text: Mint the full initial SUZHI supply of 1_000_000_000 exactly once to the configured owner principal (2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae), ensuring it cannot double-mint on redeploy/upgrade (use a persisted initialMintCompleted guard).
acceptanceCriteria: After deployment, the owner principal balance equals 1_000_000_000 (minus any transfers made later).
Subsequent upgrades do not mint again; total supply remains unchanged except for transfers (no inflation).
No references to the placeholder owner principal string remain in owner-check logic or error messages.

requirements.text: Update backend transfer/balance APIs to be consistent: either (a) keep the existing backend methods used by the current frontend (getBalance(principal) and transfer(to, amount)) as backward-compatible wrappers around the ICRC-1 ledger, or (b) update the frontend React Query hooks and wallet UI to call the ICRC-1 transfer/balance endpoints. Ensure user-facing text remains in English.
acceptanceCriteria: From the Wallet section, a signed-in user can see their SUZHI balance and successfully transfer tokens to another valid principal.
On transfer success, the sender balance decreases and the recipient balance increases by the transfer amount.
If the sender attempts to transfer more than their balance, the UI shows an English error message indicating insufficient balance (no silent failure).

requirements.text: Ensure all token ledger state required for balances, total supply, mint-guard (initialMintCompleted), and any token metadata is preserved across upgrades using stable state and, if applicable, backend/migration.mo under the project's conditional migration policy.
acceptanceCriteria: After an upgrade, previously minted balances and transfer history effects (resulting balances) remain intact.
If a migration step is required due to state shape changes, the upgrade completes without traps and preserves prior user balances from the pre-ICRC in-memory map (where possible).

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit frontend files under frontend/src/components/ui or the immutable hook/bootstrap paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose instead of editing those).
Use English for any user-facing text.
nonGoals: Do not add a separate token canister or multi-canister architecture for this change.
Do not add third-party wallet integrations or non-Internet-Identity authentication.
Do not introduce new product features beyond making SUZHI minting/ledger real and correctly reflected in the existing wallet UI.
